subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as a channel/plugin-owned opt-in buffer, a shared channel SDK or gateway coalescer, or deferred while only narrow channel bugs are fixed?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes public config shape, turn boundaries, latency, and channel lifecycle semantics, so a repair PR should not choose the permanent product/API boundary by itself.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in affected channel plugins first, sharing helpers only where duplication becomes real.

options.title: Design a shared coalescer
options.body: Create a channel SDK or gateway media coalescing contract before implementation, accepting a larger compatibility and API review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep text debounce and Telegram album handling as supported behavior, and handle only narrow bugs such as WhatsApp steer-media loss separately.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in affected channel plugins first, sharing helpers only where duplication becomes real.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared debounce policy, channel/plugin boundaries, and config compatibility, matching the history around `src/channels/inbound-debounce-policy.ts`.
